verdicts.reason: A breaks up the flavour pills: Blood Orange sits above the headline, Honey Rosemary is in the middle, and Cucumber Mint is stranded below the legal text, so the reading order is jumbled. The GLACIER wordmark is blown up and pushed below the headline, and the gaps between elements are uneven. B keeps the pills in one block above the CTA and puts the legal text last, which is a sensible top-to-bottom order. It still has flaws: the pill order is changed, the pills have different widths and ragged centred edges with large gaps between them, the wordmark is oversized and sits below the headline, and the legal text is tiny and crowded against the decorative circle.
